items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: actually Mark got me on Chaka’s gig

ctx.x: And extended beyond where you thought. I love that.

That’s a little tune I wrote called “Country.” And I was actually thinking about where I grew up, just outside of Prospect. We had a half mile dirt road from where the bus would drop us off to where our farm was. And I walked down that road many times. And one morning I was just kind of thinking about that and I heard this little melody and these changes, and sketched it out and had this little tune. And one day, Mark Hatch is one of my dearest, dearest best friends. Tremendous flugelhorn/trumpet player. He was…
Okay. The last blindfold is a lyric. Who wrote, “they say the cause is true, but then again they always do.”
